ideas.pitch: An automated prompt-to-app pipeline that takes a plain English problem description and scaffolds a fully deployed MVP with built-in test suites.
ideas.problem_statement: Build, test, and deploy a functional Minimum Viable Product (MVP) from a problem statement revealed at the event using approved AI tools.
ideas.title: PromptCircuit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly hits the core hackathon mandate of prompt engineering, rapid deployment, and verifiable prompt-to-product execution.

ideas.pitch: A live prompt history visualizer and iterative debugger that records how prompts evolved into working code during a constrained build session.
ideas.problem_statement: Key prompt history demonstrating iteration and debugging as part of submission requirements.
ideas.title: PromptTrace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fulfills the explicit submission requirement for prompt iteration history while giving judges an interactive tool to replay the team's build process.

ideas.pitch: An automated pre-deployment security and functionality scanner designed specifically for AI-generated codebases.
ideas.problem_statement: Demonstrating smart prompt engineering, building a usable product, and delivering a successful deployment.
ideas.title: AuditPrompt
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the common failure mode of rushed hackathon MVPs—broken deployments and security holes—which judges will appreciate.

ideas.pitch: A collaborative prompt workspace that lets team members concurrently test and merge prompt variants into a unified deployment script.
ideas.problem_statement: Team Formation: Teams must consist of 2–3 participants collaborating to transform an idea into a working product.
ideas.title: PromptSync
ideas.why_it_could_win: Optimizes team workflow specifically for 2-3 person teams under strict time limits, ensuring no duplicate effort on prompt tuning.

ideas.pitch: An automated QA agent that walks through a newly deployed live product URL and grades its alignment with the initial problem statement.
ideas.problem_statement: Each team must submit a publicly accessible live product URL and a short screen-recorded demo.
ideas.title: InstantEval
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the exact judging bottleneck of evaluating multiple rapid MVPs by providing an instant automated demo walkthrough.
